Screen 01b · Home — Empty State · Annotations
1
Empty State Trigger
Shown when the user has zero active competition entries — either on first sign-up, or when all previously entered competitions have ended and no new ones have been joined. Between-season gaps are a known occurrence; this state should feel welcoming rather than broken.
2
Browse Competitions CTA
Primary action — navigates directly to the Competition Browser (Screen 02). Full-width button to give it maximum prominence. Once the user joins a competition, this screen transitions to the populated Home (Screen 01).
3
Create or Join a League
Secondary action for users who are arriving via a league invite link, or who want to set up their private league before joining a competition. Navigates to the League List (Screen 09). Lower visual weight than the primary CTA — ghost/text style.
4
News Feed Always Visible
The EC news feed is shown regardless of competition status — it gives the empty state useful content and keeps the app feeling live. Same articles, same card style as the News tab (Screen 15). Helps retain users who are browsing before committing to a competition entry.
